_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The Game Boy or Game Boy Color game: the cartridge's contents, a .gb or .gbc file (.sgb for a Super Game Boy one). In a Game Boy Link machine, the game of P1's Game Boy.

slots.title: P2's game
slots.help: The game of P2's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.

slots.title: P3's game
slots.help: The game of P3's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.

slots.title: P4's game
slots.help: The game of P4's Game Boy in a Game Boy Link machine: a .gb or .gbc file. It may be the same game as another Game Boy's.

slots.title: Saved data
slots.help: The cartridge's battery-backed memory at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it, or a .sav file of Gambatte's or of another emulator. A cartridge with a clock keeps the clock's registers after the memory, as Gambatte writes them; a file without them starts the clock at zero. In a Game Boy Link machine, P1's. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with the cartridge's memory empty.
slots.nameHelp: a saved-data file is identified by its extension, .sav.

slots.title: P2's saved data
slots.help: The battery-backed memory of P2's cartridge at the start, in a Game Boy Link machine, as for P1's saved data: a file Export Save Data writes ("P2 <game>.sav") or a .sav file of Gambatte's or another emulator's. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with the cartridge's memory empty.
slots.nameHelp: a saved-data file is identified by its extension, .sav.
